prompt: Please check that the Reports page works for every project. Someone said a widget is missing for Documentation.

truth.summary: Documentation has no completed issues, so CycleTimeWidget reads sorted[0] of an empty array and calls toFixed on undefined. WidgetBoundary catches the error and renders null, so the widget silently disappears.

referenceAnswer.cause: With no completed issues, percentile() returns undefined and .toFixed throws; WidgetBoundary catches it and renders nothing.

decoyAnswers.cause: The workload feature flag hides the widget.
The cycle-time request fails for Documentation.

referenceFix.find: const days = this.props.report.samples.map((sample) => sample.days).sort((a, b) => a - b)

genieEvidence.notes: react_error_state reports the caught error exactly: boundary WidgetBoundary at reports-page.tsx, throwing component CycleTimeWidget, message, and a blankTreeHint. The stack is null.
